title: Xbox Brings Its Free Tier Of Cloud Gaming To Loads More Players Today
text: Xbox Brings Its Free Tier Of Cloud Gaming To Loads More Players Today | Pure Xbox Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Pure Xbox News Reviews Features Games Guides Videos Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Xbox Xbox Cloud Gaming Xbox Brings Its Free Tier Of Cloud Gaming To Loads More Players Today Could prove popular for GTA 6? by Fraser Gilbert 2 hours ago Share: You may recall that back in July, Xbox announced a new free version of Xbox Cloud Gaming that would allow you to play games at no charge, but you'd be forced to deal with ads as a compromise. That tier of Xbox Cloud Gaming was in testing for months, but as of today (November 11th), it's rolled out publicly - meaning the vast majority of Xbox users around the world should now have access to it. Xbox has been very quiet about it today so far, but based on what we've seen around the web, the free tier of Xbox Cloud Gaming will provide you with a 30-minute slot to stream "select games from your library" as well as select free-to-play games, after which time you'll be kicked off and will have to start a new session. You'll see ads before the session begins, and seemingly never again throughout your 30-minute playtime. "You can stream select games for free by watching ads before each gaming session. Session time limits apply. After a session ends, you can watch another set of ads to start a new session." Related Articles News Xbox Introduces Free Game Streaming With Ads, Outlines Five Principles They'll Adhere To Rolling out now as a "test" for Xbox Insiders You now have more ways to stream and play your favorite games. Purchase ad-free cloud playtime, get monthly cloud playtime with @XBOXGamePass , or stream your games for free with ad-supported cloud gaming. Choose your way to play: https://t.co/60P9n1npR5 pic.twitter.com/Lh8phIKBEF - XBOX (@XBOX) November 11, 2026 Despite the rapid session length, this could prove a popular option for anyone who wants to play GTA 6 on Xbox One (for example) without being forced to pay anything for Xbox Cloud Gaming. We'd urge some caution for now though, as Xbox has yet to confirm whether GTA 6 will be one of the "select" games that supports this feature. Meanwhile, the cloud playtime limits that were announced a while ago for Xbox Game Pass members have now started kicking in, which also means you can now purchase "Cloud Playtime" to top it up if you run out. The prices for this here in the UK are as follows: Cloud Playtime - 10 hours (£2.99) Cloud Playtime - 25 hours (£5.99) Cloud Playtime - 50 hours (£8.99) Curiously though, I've checked the new "Cloud Playtime" option in the Settings menu on my Xbox Series X and I'm being informed that I've still got "Unlimited" access to Xbox Cloud Gaming with my Ultimate membership, so it might be worth checking the same thing on your end and seeing what it says for you. I'm not the only person who's spotted something similar: Ok, I'm very confused here by u/EdgerunnerGamerHD in xcloud Anyway, we've thrown Xbox's official tweet up above, and you can hit the link in it to find out even more details.
